title: Rail Car Repairers
description: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul railroad rolling stock, mine cars, or mass transit rail cars.

tasks.text: Record conditions of cars, and repair and maintenance work performed or to be performed.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Inspect components such as bearings, seals, gaskets, wheels, and coupler assemblies to determine if repairs are needed.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Mechanical component inspection requires hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical components of vehicles to identify problems.

tasks.text: Repair or replace defective or worn parts such as bearings, pistons, and gears, using hand tools, torque wrenches, power tools, and welding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Inspect the interior and exterior of rail cars coming into rail yards to identify defects and to determine the extent of wear and damage.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Overall vehicle condition inspection is physical

dwas.name: Inspect vehicles to determine overall condition.

tasks.text: Remove locomotives, car mechanical units, or other components, using pneumatic hoists and jacks, pinch bars, hand tools, and cutting torches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing equipment components requires manual dexterity

dwas.name: Remove parts or components from equipment.

tasks.text: Test units for operability before and after repairs.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Completed-work function check is physical

dwas.name: Inspect completed work to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Adjust repaired or replaced units as needed to ensure proper operation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Repair, fabricate, and install steel or wood fittings, using blueprints, shop sketches, and instruction manuals.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Install vehicle parts or accessories.
Fabricate parts or components.
Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Perform scheduled maintenance, and clean units and components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Service vehicles to maintain functionality.

tasks.text: Examine car roofs for wear and damage, and repair defective sections, using roofing material, cement, nails, and waterproof paint.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical vehicle structural inspection requires hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect structural components of vehicles to identify problems.
Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Paint car exteriors, interiors, and fixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Painting surfaces is hands-on manual work

dwas.name: Paint surfaces or equipment.

tasks.text: Repair and maintain electrical and electronic controls for propulsion and braking systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on electronic equipment repair

dwas.name: Repair electronic equipment.

tasks.text: Disassemble units such as water pumps, control valves, and compressors so that repairs can be made.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Measure diameters of axle wheel seats, using micrometers, and mark dimensions on axles so that wheels can be bored to specified dimensions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical distance measurement in field

dwas.name: Measure distances or dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Test electrical systems of cars by operating systems and using testing equipment such as ammeters.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Electrical testing requires hands-on instrument use

dwas.name: Test electrical equipment or systems to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Replace defective wiring and insulation, and tighten electrical connections, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Rewiring systems is hands-on electrical work

dwas.name: Rewire electrical or electronic systems.

tasks.text: Install and repair interior flooring, fixtures, walls, plumbing, steps, and platforms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Structural repair is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Install hardware or other interior fixtures.
Repair structural components.

tasks.text: Repair window sash frames, attach weather stripping and channels to frames, and replace window glass, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical glass removal and installation

dwas.name: Seal gaps or cracks to prevent leakage or moisture intrusion.
Replace vehicle glass.
Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Align car sides for installation of car ends and crossties, using width gauges, turnbuckles, and wrenches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical alignment of machinery requires hands

dwas.name: Align equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Repair car upholstery.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on automotive component repair

dwas.name: Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.
